# Signia

Signia is a browser-only email signature generator: fill in a form, pick a template and accent color, and get a clean, email-safe HTML signature you can copy or download — no backend, no account, no tracking.

- Source: [github.com/cristianrubioa/signia](https://github.com/cristianrubioa/signia)
- Live app: [signia.crubio.fyi](https://signia.crubio.fyi/)
